faqs.question: Q1) Is this really free?
faqs.answer: Yes absolutely, it's completely free for the first 10 clients.

faqs.question: Q2) Why are you doing this for free?
faqs.answer: I'm building my portfolio and reputation. In return for the free store, I ask for honest video reviews that I can share on my Community Hub to help future clients trust my work.

faqs.question: Q3) If you're so knowledgeable about dropshipping, why aren't you doing it yourself?
faqs.answer: I'm a developer, not a merchant. My passion is writing code and building stores, not running ads or managing inventory. I have zero interest in competing with my clients—my entire business model is helping others succeed. Your niche is yours, period.

faqs.question: Q4) What services do you offer?
faqs.answer: Except finding the dealers, I do everything.

faqs.question: Q5) How will you handle the payment gateways?
faqs.answer: We will guide you step by step so you can connect your own Stripe, PayPal, or other payment processors yourself. You stay in 100% control of your money at all times.

faqs.question: Q6) What happens if the solution is not working?
faqs.answer: If the store itself has bugs, I fix them for free. If your marketing strategy doesn't generate sales, I am happy to offer free strategic advice based on my research—but ultimately, sales depend on your ads and product-market fit. I am here to help you succeed, but I cannot guarantee sales.

faqs.question: Q7) What's the community hub?
faqs.answer: It's a place where the reviews and the stores links are present with some pictures or videos of the clients we served for free. You will be able to see the way the solution works. It's view-only for now; later it will be view and comments.

faqs.question: Q8) What format of solution will you offer?
faqs.answer: I can offer it in various ways: GitHub public repo, zip file, raw files, or any other method that doesn't require me to pay for subscriptions.

faqs.question: Q9) Do you agree with verification of the codes?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. It's your code—you should definitely verify it. I will fully cooperate with you to ensure you're comfortable, as long as it doesn't require me to pay for any third-party tools or subscriptions.

faqs.question: Q10) If you're saying you won't need any Shopify details, how will you work?
faqs.answer: I will build you a full store from scratch, so the problems you're facing won't come back.

faqs.question: Q11) Why did you choose the name Vanta Forge?
faqs.answer: It reflects my work—like a secret forge where development happens behind the scenes.

faqs.question: Q12) Do you use templates?
faqs.answer: No, I don't use templates. I use AI tools like Gemini and DeepSeek to accelerate the repetitive parts of frontend development (like product grids and page layouts). All critical business logic—payment processing, security, and API integrations—is hand-coded and tested by me, a professional engineer.

faqs.question: Q13) Where can I check my site for malicious code?
faqs.answer: You can check it using antivirus software, AI tools, and other sources. I will fully cooperate with you until you're completely comfortable with the code.

faqs.question: Q14) When your solution is completed, what happens next?
faqs.answer: After you implement the solutions on your site, I will stay with you until you're fully satisfied. Your registration data is stored securely via Google Forms. If you ever feel insecure, I'm happy to walk you through every line of code.

faqs.question: Q15) Warning
faqs.answer: Never give any password or Shopify details to anyone. I don't need or ask for those. Use a secondary email for communication if you prefer—never share your Shopify-registered email or any real credentials. Your security is your responsibility.
